title: SURF Test Unit measurement blueprint
description: Schema for the JSON measurement-sequence DSL executed by InterpreterThread.run in software/surf_terminal/terminal.py. Numeric bounds mirror the firmware axis limits in firmware/axis/SURF_nanoAxis_v5/SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino. See docs/blueprint-format.md; deviations from the interpreter's own tolerance are listed there under 'Schema strictness'.

name.description: Human-readable title. Echoed to the console at start and stored as blueprint_name in the measurement log.

heatingpads.description: Overrides the heating-pad annotation written into the evaluation config file. Either the literal 'OFF' or a setpoint in degrees Celsius as a string (e.g. '32'). Without this key the value is derived from the first heat step, then from a '_T<n>' suffix in the file name, then defaults to 'OFF' (terminal.py:137-146).

measCouchType.description: Overrides the couch-rotation annotation written into the evaluation config file. Without this key it is derived from the number of distinct couch angles across all qa_input steps (terminal.py:130-135).

axisPositionH.description: Absolute target of the horizontal slide in mm. Bounds are the firmware limits LIMIT_H_MIN/LIMIT_H_MAX (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:55-56). The PC does NOT range-check blueprint moves; an out-of-range target is silently discarded by the firmware and still acknowledged as done.

axisPositionV.description: Absolute target of the vertical slide in mm. Bounds are LIMIT_V_MIN/LIMIT_V_MAX (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:61-62).

axisPositionR.description: Absolute target of the rotation stage in degrees. Bounds are LIMIT_R_MIN/LIMIT_R_MAX (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:67-68). A move is rejected outright until the R axis has been zeroed (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:152).

type.description: Step discriminator. A type outside this list is silently ignored by the interpreter, which is why the schema restricts it.

moveStep.description: One blocking absolute move. Axes present in the step are driven SEQUENTIALLY in the fixed order H, V, R (terminal.py:724) regardless of JSON key order; they never move simultaneously.

speed.description: Feed rate applied to every axis of this step: mm/s for H and V, deg/s for R. A speed that encodes to 0 steps/s makes the firmware's move loop spin forever (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:368) and must never be used. The terminal truncates int(speed * steps_per_unit) (terminal.py:739), so any R speed below 1/16.156 = 0.0619 deg/s already encodes to 0; hence minimum 0.062 rather than exclusiveMinimum 0.
Linear-axis cap MAX_SPEED_MM_S = 50 mm/s (SURF_nanoAxis_v5.ino:42). Higher values are clamped by the firmware, so the commanded and the executed profile would differ.

delayStep.description: Interruptible wait. Resolution is 0.1 s and the elapsed time is accumulated in 0.1 s increments, so the realised delay is slightly longer than requested (terminal.py:798-801).

heatStep.description: Sets one or both heating-pad setpoints. Values are surface (outer) temperatures; the terminal converts them to the pad-internal setpoint before sending (terminal.py:597-598).

wait_steady.description: Block until every pad named in this step is flagged stable, or for 120 s, whichever comes first (terminal.py:756-790). On timeout the operator is prompted and may abort. Default false.

padSetpoint.description: Heating-pad surface setpoint in degrees Celsius. The upper bound matches the manual-entry band the GUI enforces (terminal.py:1139, 1258); blueprint heat steps bypass that check, so the bound is imposed here instead. The firmware additionally clamps the internal setpoint to 0-65 C (SURF_nanoHeating_v4.ino:143).

checkpointStep.description: Blocking Yes/No gate. 'No' aborts the blueprint. The answer is recorded in the measurement log (terminal.py:702-719).

msg.description: Prompt text shown to the operator.

logCheckpointStep.description: Recording checkpoint: writes an operator answer into the measurement log without gating the run, unless abort_on_no is set (terminal.py:815-830, 1406-1429).

key.description: Identifier under which the answer is stored in the 'bedingungen' map of the measurement log. Restricted to word characters so entries stay machine-readable.

mode.description: 'yesno' records a boolean, 'text' records a free-text note. Any other value is treated as 'yesno'. Default 'yesno'.

msg.description: Prompt text shown to the operator.

abort_on_no.description: Only meaningful with mode 'yesno': answering No aborts the blueprint. Default false. Cancelling a 'text' dialog never aborts.
abort_on_no has no effect in text mode; the interpreter always proceeds (terminal.py:1411-1414).

loggingStep.description: Starts or stops the phantom telemetry CSV and, on start, the QA CSV (terminal.py:804-808, 1482-1529).

action.description: 'start' opens data/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<prefix>_<timestamp>.csv plus <prefix>_<timestamp>_QA.csv; 'stop' closes them and saves the temperature plot. Any other value is a no-op.

prefix.description: File-name stem of the measurement CSVs. No path separators. Default 'messung'. Make it unique per blueprint - the output file name is the only in-file record of which sequence produced the data.

qaInputStep.description: Blocking operator measurement entry. In QA mode a point_id matching 'endposition_d<n>' (or the legacy '<min|max>verschub') additionally forces an ExacTrac timestamp dialog and appends an entry to the evaluation config file (terminal.py:657-699).

mode.description: 'sphere_detection' collects X/Y/Z only; 'surface_tracking' and 'both' additionally collect pitch/yaw/roll (terminal.py:855-857). Only 'surface_tracking' fills the Surf_X/Y/Z columns of the QA CSV (terminal.py:1550-1553).

point_id.description: Measurement-point label, written verbatim to the QA CSV. It is also the metadata carrier: 'endposition_d<n>' sets the deflection index, 'couch<angle>' or 'couch_<angle>' sets the couch angle (0 if absent). A point_id matching neither 'endposition_d<n>' nor '<min|max>verschub' produces no ExacTrac prompt and no config entry.

msg.description: Instruction shown above the input fields.

deflection.description: Explicit deflection index, overriding the value parsed from point_id (terminal.py:666). Setting it forces the ExacTrac prompt even for a point_id that carries no deflection marker.

couch_angle.description: Explicit couch angle in degrees, overriding the value parsed from point_id (terminal.py:668). Also counted when deriving meas_couch_type (terminal.py:134).

etds_msg.description: Custom prompt for the ExacTrac timestamp dialog (terminal.py:675).
